items.label: 【Partitioned Storage】
items.value: The wine bar cabinet has ample internal storage space with 3 integrated stemware racks. The pull-out wine bottle storage space is convenient and quick(the drawers are smooth gliding). The bottom drawers can store bar tools, and independent cabinets with removable shelves can freely customize the space according to the size of the items.

items.label: 【Furniture-grade Materials】
items.value: This coffee bar cabinet is made of P2-grade MDF, paired with tempered glass cabinet doors, and supported by 4 sturdy metal legs for long-term use. Environmentally friendly lead-free paint is safe and healthy. Just wipe it with a damp cloth in daily life.

items.label: 【Exquisite and stylish design】
items.value: This liquor buffet cabinet is available in two finishes. Gold accessories embellish the stylish green and classic black, creating a timeless modern look. It is perfect for adding a touch of elegance to your dining room, living room, or kitchen.

items.label: 【Space-saving design】
items.value: This compact bar cabinet with storage measures 37 inches x 14.96 inches x 31.49 inches, suitable for placement in any room without taking up space. It is a stylish and practical solution for storing beverages, glassware, and bar necessities.

items.label: 【Easy to Assemble】
items.value: Designed with user-friendly assembly in mind, this buffet storage cabinet comes with clear instructions and all necessary hardware. Each component is labeled for easy identification, simplifying the assembly process. You'll have your home bar installed in no time.
